summary: Iteration 4 review of Skiller. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter4.py with 28 new pytest cases — all pass. Total backend regression after the server.py -> routers refactor: 80/80 (52 prior + 28 new). Coverage for iter4: GET /api/search (empty q -> 422, missing q -> 422, react/maya/design queries return populated counts, case-insensitive, limit respected, no _id leak), GET /api/push/vapid-public-key returns ~87-char base64-url public key, POST /api/push/subscribe requires auth (401), idempotent on duplicate endpoint (one DB row, active=true), POST /api/push/unsubscribe sets active=false, invalid empty subscription returns ok=false, create_notification with fake FCM endpoint completes (follow API returns 200 even when push fails), forgot-password with RESEND_API_KEY empty returns ok for known + unknown emails (no enumeration). Smoke for refactor: auth/me, posts/feed+explore, courses, gigs, users/{username}, dashboard/stats, notifications, /api/leaderboard, users/me/xp, ai/recommend, ads/active — all 200. Frontend: brand color verified — --primary HSL is '0 74% 42%' in light and '0 72% 51%' in dark, exactly per spec. /sw.js served HTTP 200, contains 'push' + 'notificationclick' handlers. navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js') succeeds, scope = origin. Notification.permission = 'denied' in headless Chromium, so ensurePushSubscription gracefully no-ops (no errors logged, no push subscribe POST attempted). Search bar: data-testid='search-input' visible top-right (and one more in mobile-topbar), typing 'react' shows data-testid='search-dropdown' with 250ms debounce, pressing Enter navigates to /search?q=react. /search page renders data-testid='search-page' with user link href='/u/arjun', a course link, and a gig link; clicking user link navigates to /u/arjun. Previously-passing flows still load: /feed, /courses, /gigs, /dashboard (stats grid + tabs visible), notifications-bell present in header. Welcome-back toast shown on login. No new console errors beyond a pre-existing benign ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED (3rd-party telemetry). Demo passwords confirmed working — Maya/Arjun/Neha all Demo@123 at end of run.

minor.issue: When subscription.endpoint is missing, returns 200 with {ok: false} instead of 422. Functional but inconsistent with FastAPI validation conventions — consider raising HTTPException(422).

Mongo $regex with re.escape is unindexed; for large datasets this will scan collections. Add text indexes on users.username/name, posts.caption/tags, courses.title/description, gigs.title/skills. Acceptable for current seed.

action_items: (Optional) /api/push/subscribe: raise 422 for missing endpoint instead of returning 200 with ok=false.
(Optional) Add Mongo text indexes for /api/search to scale beyond seed-sized data.
(Carry-over from iter3) NotificationsBell.jsx: guard against React StrictMode double-mount causing 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established.' warnings.
(Carry-over from iter3) /api/ws invalid-token: accept() then close(code=4401) so client gets 4401 instead of HTTP 403.
(Carry-over) Add Mongo TTL index on password_reset_tokens.expires_at; gate PASSWORD_RESET_LINK log behind APP_ENV != production.
(New) RESEND_API_KEY is unset (expected) — once set, verify HTML email actually delivers; current test suite cannot end-to-end verify Resend send.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now slim (~74 lines) — refactor goal achieved; routers/ module structure clean. Consider also moving startup hooks (seed, init_storage, init_vapid_keys) into a startup.py to keep server.py purely declarative.

routers/search.py uses re.escape inside $regex; safe against ReDoS but not indexed. Consider Mongo $text + $meta:'textScore' for ranking, which would also be naturally case-insensitive without per-query regex compilation.

routers/push.py: subscribe ignores keys validation — a subscription with endpoint but no p256dh/auth keys will be stored but pywebpush will fail at send. Validate keys.p256dh and keys.auth presence on subscribe.

notifications_service.send_web_push: ensure 410/404 from push gateway marks sub inactive — current test path showed the doc remains (couldn't verify inactive flip with fake FCM endpoint, since gateway DNS-resolved but did not return 410). Fine in production but flag for future telemetry.
seed.init_vapid_keys: VAPID private key persisted in db.config — ensure this collection is not exposed by any future admin API; currently safe.

frontend SearchBar fires GET /api/search?q= on every keystroke after 250ms debounce — fine, but consider AbortController to cancel in-flight requests when query changes, to prevent stale results on slow connections.
frontend /sw.js is plain JS in public/ — consider versioning (e.g., '/sw.js?v=4') to bust caches when push payload format changes.

Two visible search-input elements (mobile + desktop) share data-testid='search-input' — this trips Playwright strict mode. Suggest data-testid='search-input-desktop' and 'search-input-mobile' for robust selectors.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (push end-to-end un-testable due to headless Notification.permission=denied; verified graceful no-op path)

Two search-input elements exist (mobile + desktop) — use page.locator('[data-testid="search-input"]').last in Playwright. rca of the issue: No bugs blocking iteration 4 sign-off. Carry-over minor items from iter3 (WS close code 4401, StrictMode WS double-connect warning) remain open and are cosmetic. The two new minor backend items (push subscribe validation strictness, search index strategy) are pre-emptive scalability/UX nits, not regressions.
